description: Canonical registry of the services the extension talks to, surfaced in Settings -> Experimental -> Integrations. Health is probed on demand only (no polling). Five kinds: 'http' and 'docker' are daemons with an idempotent Start-*/Stop-* pair in this directory; 'embedded' is a native module linked into the extension host, so its start script provisions rather than launches; 'binary' is an executable invoked per call, probed by running it, with no port to be green about; 'remote' is a third-party endpoint we depend on but do not run, listed so an outage is visible instead of looking like an empty result set. A 'port' here is a claim that some code connects to it — do not add one to an integration that is not reached over TCP.

services.name: BeeLlama (llama.cpp)
services.label: BeeLlama (llama.cpp)
services.description: Local LLM server. Default preset 96k-mtp; one or two llama.cpp slots depending on preset.

services.name: Qwen3-VL Intel Xe (GPU.0)
services.label: Qwen3-VL Intel Xe (GPU.0)
services.description: Canonical vision lane. OpenVINO GenAI ContinuousBatching backend on 20000 pinned to the Intel Xe iGPU, fronted by the OpenAI-compatible gateway on 8102. This is the lane Vision Angels, TemporalVisionClient and the Kelvin Vision provider profile all dial. Resident: start it once and leave it up.

services.name: Qwen3-VL CPU (on demand)
services.label: Qwen3-VL CPU (on demand)
services.description: Second engine on the CPU: same model and server as the Xe lane, backend on 20002 and gateway on 8103, so both lanes run at once. On demand - nothing auto-starts it. Slower than Xe for interactive use and it holds ~17 GB resident, so stop it when idle. Also the correctness oracle: the CPU plugin bounds-checks the DeepStack scatter that the GPU plugin does not.

services.name: OpenVINO NPU Retrieval
services.label: OpenVINO NPU Retrieval
services.description: Native embeddings/reranker server on the Intel NPU (not Docker).

services.name: Qdrant Vector DB
services.label: Qdrant Vector DB
services.description: BLACKGLASS vector plane (spec §17) and IdeaWell substrate. Docker Compose service persisting to volume qdrant_storage. Down means reduced recall, not an outage: retrieval falls back to exact anchors and graph traversal.

services.name: LadybugDB Security Graph
services.label: LadybugDB Security Graph
services.description: BLACKGLASS graph plane (spec §3.2/§30). Embedded native module, not a daemon — there is no port. Absent means the security hypergraph is in-memory and does not survive a window reload.

services.name: Joern Code Property Graph
services.label: Joern Code Property Graph
services.description: BLACKGLASS reachability plane (spec §10/§11). Invoked per query as a CLI, not a daemon — JoernCodeGraphAdapter runs the binary with an argument array and a timeout. Requires a JDK 17+. Absent means reachability is UNKNOWN — never 'not reachable' (§35) — so no attack chain can reach STATIC_CONFIRMED.

services.name: OSV Advisory Feed
services.label: OSV Advisory Feed
services.description: Public vulnerability feed consumed by AdvisoryIngestor (spec §10.1). Third-party and not started locally; listed so 'the feed is down' is distinguishable from 'no advisories affect this package'.
